# Monopolises

Monopolises is a governed research asset.

Current status: Gate MON-G0-RH is closed as FAIL.

The first repository-era thesis, Strategic Replaceability / Replacement Horizon, was tested across five fixed cases. All five produced useful evidence-bounded transition records, but none produced a single canonical strategic Replacement Horizon without unresolved methodological choice.

No successor category thesis is currently authorized.
